data.title: 迦摩 · 新年神社的签运
data.description: 冬装参拜，她抽到大吉后举起来得意洋洋，说这是「魔王应得的运势」；风把签文吹走时被树枝挂住，她踮着脚够了半天够不到，最后装作毫不在意地离开。
data.action: 冬装参拜，她抽到大吉后举起来得意洋洋，说这是「魔王应得的运势」
data.promptProse: Kama holds her favorable fortune slip upright with a victorious smile, then watches its free edge lift in a sudden gust with determined concern. Cream winter coat, plum scarf and warm trousers retain the cold-weather outfit beneath white hair. The medium view places shrine branches and tied fortunes behind her. Pale winter sunlight brightens paper and red eyes, casting a small finger shadow through the slip and soft scarf shadows on the coat.
